name: Grand Prix TR

origin.basis: Continental's bicycle tires are marketed from its German site; Germany-made lines are marked 'Handmade in Germany'.

manufacturing.basis: Continental's size table gives no made-in statement for this line.

positioning: Value tubeless-ready tire for training, commuting and long rides, using BlackChili and a 4-ply casing.
hookless_note: Continental: tubeless-ready and hookless-compatible; hookless maximum 73 psi up to 28 mm and 65 psi at 30-32 mm.
weight_basis: Continental black-sidewall claims; transparent sidewalls add 10-15 g.

availability.note: Continental's official Tmall store sells it in mainland China; Continental's German and US catalogs list it for retailers.

price_observations.market: Continental official Tmall store (德国马牌轮胎官方旗舰店)
price_observations.conditions: Tmall list price before discounts ('优惠前') on 2026-11-01; the listing text does not say whether the option is one tire or a pair. Shipping within mainland China.

caveats: About 60 g heavier per tire than the 5000 S TR at 28 mm and slower in the lab, in exchange for a tougher casing and lower price.
Use the hookless pressure limit on hookless rims.

image.shown: Black and tan-wall Grand Prix TR tires as pictured on Continental's product page; one picture covers every width.
image.alt: Two Continental Grand Prix TR tubeless-ready road tires, one black and one with tan sidewalls

rights.usage_note: The maker's own product photo, shown from the maker's website; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Coded on 2026-11-03 from a fixed source set: the written reviews on the Sigma Sports and bike-components product pages, read in full through each page's own review list in a browser (the newest 15 per page when more exist; bundle pages that add inner tubes are not read), every reader comment on Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test pages for this tire, and owner comments in coded Xiaohongshu threads. Counted only owners who describe their own riding; star-only ratings, reviews without riding detail, mounting-only impressions and repeats were left out. Colour options on the same product page count as the same tire.

reports.summary: Handles hardly differently from the GP5000 for less money.
Easy to mount and seal tubeless with a floor pump, runs true, and the owner would buy it again.
